assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and a sensation of rapid heart rate
raising clinical suspicion for supraventricular tachycardia
reports symptoms not captured by R00.2
a mobile cardiac telemetry study (CPT 93229) is ordered for continuous rhythm monitoring
The payer requires prior authorization (CO-197) for this diagnostic procedure
The service is medically necessary to detect the arrhythmia during symptomatic episodes as documented in the indication note
